description: VGGT-Omega -> COLMAP export summary for the ForeSplat GGGS frontend.
scene_alignment_note: T_align = inv(E0) @ opengl_conversion @ rotY(180) - applied ONCE to both the 3D points and the camera poses (identical to the community GLB exporter); no additional Y/Z flip is performed afterwards.
point_semantics: Every points3D entry is a single-view depth back-projection from its own image's VGGT-Omega depth map, filtered by the RAP-FSAM3 foreground mask (foreground & finite geometry & valid confidence & valid depth). Tracks contain exactly one 2D observation each; reprojection error is undefined (zero) and must not be interpreted as bundle-adjustment residuals.
